净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Improves the parent's cycle z-score by applying a 5-day rolling average to smooth out short-term noise, which is expected to improve IC and RankICIR while preserving the core mean-reversion mechanism and the strong payoff characteristics. The cs_rank transform is retained for cross-sectional comparability.

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(z = (close - ts_mean(200, close)) / ts_std(20, close); smoothed = ts_mean(5, z))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_mean(AdjClose, 200)), ts_std(AdjClose, 20)), 5)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_mean(AdjClose, 200)), ts_std(AdjClose, 20))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjClose, ts_mean(AdjClose, 200))
  4. 4. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(AdjClose, 200)
  5. 5. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(AdjClose, 20)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 mean_window：200
  3. 计算 vol_window：20
  4. 计算 min_periods：50
  5. 计算 rolling_mean：close.rolling(mean_window, min_periods=min_periods).mean()
  6. 计算 rolling_std：close.rolling(vol_window, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
  7. 计算 zscore：(close - rolling_mean) / rolling_std
  8. 计算 smoothed：zscore.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=5).mean()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_cycle_zscore_smoothed(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] mean_window = 200 vol_window = 20 min_periods = 50 rolling_mean = close.rolling(mean_window, min_periods=min_periods).mean() rolling_std = close.rolling(vol_window, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1) zscore = (close - rolling_mean) / rolling_std.replace(0.0, np.nan) "com"># smooth with 5-day rolling mean to reduce noise smoothed = zscore.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean() "kw">class="kw">return smoothed.rename("factor_cycle_zscore_smoothed")
